concerns.text: FR-003 requires BH correction 'for the cross-sectional ROR/PRR/IC metrics, outputting adjusted p-values for every metric', but T006 computes a single Fisher-exact raw p-value and a single p_value_adj. No per-metric (ROR/PRR/IC) adjusted p-values are produced anywhere in the task list — a semantic weakening of FR-003 that the deterministic FR-012 check would miss.

US3 scenario 2 requires 'the final output list contains only SOCs with an adjusted p-value < 0.05' after BH correction. No task implements this filter or reports an adj-p<0.05-restricted list; T006 flags signals solely by the 2-of-3 threshold rule and T008 selects top-5 by smallest adjusted p-value. The acceptance criterion is dropped.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 vs plan.md:Constitution Check (Principle II) / Technical Context
concerns.text: T002 downloads from guessed HHS zip URLs ('https://vaers.hhs.gov/data/datasets/{Y}VAERSDATA.csv.zip') while plan.md's constitution check asserts 'Only verified URLs from the Verified datasets block are used' and the plan's data source is a verified parquet. T002's conditional 'if the execution feedback later injects a VERIFIED REAL DATA SOURCE block... delete the guessed URLs' leaves unverified URLs as the primary recipe, violating the plan's verified-source constraint and Constitution I/II reproducibility.

SC-005 is malformed ('[deferred] of reported signals MUST satisfy the 2-out-of-3 rule') with no threshold, yet T010 check 5 claims to 'report' the proportion — a check that cannot fail. Either define a measurable criterion (e.g., 100% of is_signal=True rows satisfy 2-of-3) or the task is asserting compliance with an untestable SC.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T008 vs plan.md:Phase 4 item 2 vs spec.md:FR-004
concerns.text: Three inconsistent temporal reference points: spec FR-004 'median report date of the cohort', plan Phase 4 'median REPT_DATE of the COVID-19 cohort', T008 'median of the combined COVID + Non-COVID cohort'. T008's choice is a defensible reading of the spec but contradicts the plan; align the plan (or spec) so the implemented week_offset is unambiguous.

T011 forbids the string 'Causal' in report.md while simultaneously requiring a limitations statement that findings are 'associational (not causal)'. The case-sensitive grep passes lowercase 'causal', but the constraint as written is self-contradictory on its face; state the forbidden strings as case-sensitive exact phrases ('Post-Vaccination Time', 'Causal Effect', 'Incidence Rate') to avoid an implementer 'fixing' the limitations text.
